S50U26.today_summary: 1079.3 closed +10.0 and parked 0.7 points under the 1080 gamma flip, which fell 20 points from 1100 today. Net near-ATM GEX swung to +11,844 baht/point from +1,952 as 514 lots of 1080 calls, 320 of 1090 and 347 of 1100 built a long-gamma shelf above the money. P/C OI 2.47 is the highest in 10 sessions, but 16,430 of the 45,549 puts sit at the 910 strike on zero volume and a 44.0% quoted IV - structural burden, not active flow. Max pain 1070 is unchanged for a 10th session, 9.3 points below spot.
what_changed: Gamma flip fell 20 points to 1080 from 1100, ending its run at 1100 and leaving spot 0.7 points from the boundary.
Near-ATM net GEX jumped 6.1x to +11,844 baht/point from +1,952 as the 1080/1090/1100 calls traded 514/320/347 lots.
ATM IV compressed 0.93 points to 12.48% from 13.41% on 09-15, even as the future rallied +8.9 points over the same span.
Call OI fell 589 to 18,430 while put OI rose 650 to 45,549 since 09-15, lifting P/C OI to 2.47 from 2.36.
S50U26.five_day_thesis: Five sessions ago (09-15) the future was 1070.4 with the gamma flip 29.6 points overhead at 1100 and near-ATM GEX a thin +1,105 - dealers were short gamma through the whole traded zone, and 09-17 printed -7,319 on a 1057.8 low. Since then the future has climbed +8.9 points to 1079.3 and the flip has walked down 20 points to meet it, so the short-gamma window closed rather than price escaping it. ATM IV compressed 0.93 points to 12.48% across that same rally, which is the long-gamma signature of dealers selling into strength. Max pain has not moved off 1070 in 10 sessions while the 1100 call wall bled 66 contracts to 2,718 and the 1050 put wall shed 108 to 1,905 - structure decaying into expiry rather than rebuilding. The five-day read is a regime handover from Squeeze to Pinning, with 1080 as the hinge.

strategies.name: Iron condor 1050P/1040P x 1100C/1110C
strategies.rationale: Short strikes sit on the 10d bands - 1050 is the near put wall at 1,905 OI and 1100 the call wall at 2,718 - and +11,844 of near-ATM dealer long gamma with 12.48% ATM IV means hedging flow works against a move to either wing over 7 sessions.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 10-point wing width minus net credit, one side only; 10 points = 2,000 baht at the 200-baht multiplier.
strategies.invalidation: A close below 1070, where cumulative GEX is -3,889 and dealers flip short gamma, or above 1100.

strategies.name: 1070/1050 put debit spread
strategies.rationale: Cumulative GEX turns -3,889 at 1070, so losing the 1080 flip makes dealer hedging pro-trend to the downside; 20 points of width spans 2.4x the 8.49-point 1-sigma day with cost capped at the debit.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit paid; maximum value 20 points (4,000 baht).
strategies.invalidation: A close back above 1080 with near-ATM GEX still above +10,000.

strategies.name: 1080/1100 call debit spread
strategies.rationale: 1080 is both the flip and the largest at-money call OI at 2,305 with 514 lots traded today; holding above it keeps dealers long gamma, which caps the pace but leaves the 2,718-contract 1100 wall as the magnet, and 12.94% call IV makes the 20-point stretch cheap.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit paid; maximum value 20 points (4,000 baht).

S50U26.prediction: 1070-1090 is the base-case range into the 2026-09-29 expiry, with 1080 acting as the magnet while near-ATM GEX holds above +10,000 and the 8.49-point 1-sigma keeps a single session inside that band. A close below 1070 flips cumulative GEX negative and opens 1050, the near put wall at 1,905 OI; a close above 1100 runs into 2,718 contracts of call wall.
S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice and not a recommendation to execute any position. SET50 options are European and cash-settled on the SET50 index, so there is no physical delivery and no share-covering flow at expiry: the pull toward 1080 and max pain 1070 is a dealer-hedging tendency only, structurally weaker than pinning in physically-settled single stocks. Defined-risk is not low-risk - the condor's 10-point wing is a real 2,000-baht loss per contract and short-vol payoffs are negative-skew. The 910 put wall (16,430 OI, zero volume today, 44.0% quoted IV) fails the Vol2Vol filter and should not be read as active support.

Open interest is still building on both sides - puts +607 to 3,200 and calls +481 to 3,127 since 09-16 - with P/C OI flat at 1.02 and no near-money wall above 515 contracts. what_changed: Gamma flip walked down 20 points to 1130 from 1150 on 09-16, compressing the short-gamma zone from 78.0 to 51.5 points above spot.
Put OI added 607 contracts (+23.4%) to 3,200 against 481 calls (+18.2%) to 3,127 in 4 sessions - a two-sided build, not a directional one.
P/C volume doubled to 1.43 from 0.72 on 09-16, the first session of genuine put flow in the back quarter.
ATM IV compressed 0.92 points to 12.03% while the future rallied +6.5 points, cheapening 98-day optionality.
S50Z26.five_day_thesis: History for Z26 starts 09-16, so this is a 4-session read rather than 5. Across it the future rose 1072.0 to 1078.5 (+6.5) while ATM IV fell 12.95% to 12.03%, meaning the back quarter has repriced the rally as low-volatility drift rather than a breakout. Total OI grew 20.8% from 5,239 to 6,327 with max pain frozen at 1070 the whole way - open interest building around a level instead of migrating with price, which is the Protection signature for a young quarter. The gamma flip's 20-point walk down to 1130 is the only structural move of the window, and it narrows the short-gamma band without removing it. At +489 baht/point of total net GEX against S50U26's +10,466, nothing here is yet heavy enough to force dealer flow.
